articleTitle: Construction of Computer Application Course Assistant Teaching System under the Background of Internet Plus
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: With the vigorous development of digital economy, the pace of digital transformation and upgrading of enterprises has accelerated, and the demand for computer application professionals has continued to rise, expanding the gap of compound and innovative computer application skills talents. In this regard, this paper will put forward the construction scheme of computer application course auxiliary teaching system in view of the difficulties faced in the current education and teaching practice, such as single teaching form, insufficient teachers, and disconnection between production and teaching, in order to promote the reform of computer application course teaching mode and the transformation of personnel training objectives. The whole system uses Javaweb technology as the core to build the functional architecture, and realizes the integration of educational resources and technical means through distributed technology, forming a comprehensive application program integrating remote access, online interaction and data analysis. Practice has proved that the system integrates the concept of “school-enterprise combination” into the curriculum system, and reconstructs the teaching process from the aspects of teaching content, teaching form, teachers’ team, career planning, assessment and evaluation, and establishes the training paradigm of computer application talents in the new period.

articleTitle: Classification Method of Higher Vocational Education Students Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: It is the fundamental guarantee for formulating effective reform to classify higher vocational education students at the micro level. Firstly, a classification index system is established, which includes six primary indicators: general ideological literacy, basic professional abilities, core professional abilities, expansion professional abilities, comprehensive practical abilities, and continuous learning abilities. Each primary indicator is further subdivided into several secondary indicators. Secondly, the Analytic Hierarchy Process is used to determine the weight of primary indicators, while the weight of the secondary indicators is determined by the proportion of credits. Then, a weighted classification method based on K-Means clustering is designed, which is conducted on 261 students. The research results show that 261 students are divided into 5 types. The characteristics of the 5 types are discussed. Suggestions including clarifying the differential training path, strengthening technical skill teaching and strengthening career development education are put forward.

articleTitle: Development and Application Practice of Nursing Simulation Experiment Teaching Platform Under VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: In recent years, the application of virtual reality (VR) technology in medical education has gained significant attention. This paper introduces a research study on the development of a nursing education platform using VR technology. The study presents a VR pediatric nursing education platform that employs high-fidelity virtual scenarios and interactive modes to facilitate immersive learning. The platform includes simulation cases designed for various pediatric illnesses, enabling students to acquire nursing knowledge and skills within a virtual environment. Detailed explanations are provided for aspects such as needs analysis, system design, scene modeling, interaction design, and platform implementation. Teaching applications have demonstrated that VR education can enhance students’ interest and engagement in learning, as well as improve their ability to apply theoretical knowledge to practical situations. Overall, the research illustrates the promising prospects of VR technology in medical nursing education and contributes to advancements in healthcare education models.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning-based Art Creation Method and Its Application in Art Space Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Multimedia art is a comprehensive audio-visual art type, which utilises a variety of elements such as graphics, text, sound and image to support the spatial representation of the work. Therefore, the virtual space form of multimedia art is formed and expressed by the spatial structure of the elements, and in the creation of specific multimedia art works, we must implement the spatial theory into the spatial expression of specific elements. In this paper, based on the deep learning background of big data on the creation of new research and analysis of art, the creation of art and deep learning big data on the combination of research, research not only on the creation of new breakthroughs in art, but also on the deep learning technology for in-depth exploration and research.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition in the Education Domain Based on BERT-BiLSTM-CRF - Using Data Structures as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: In the field of education, due to the use of traditional methods for named entity identification, there are some cases where the entity feature information extraction accuracy is relatively low, and the identification efficiency is relatively low. This paper presents a named entity identification research approach based on the BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model. This method first uses the pre-training model of BERT (Bidirectional encoder representations from transformers) to obtain the word vector of the input sequence semantic; Then the trained word vector is input into the bidirectional long and short-term memory network Model to obtain contextual features; Finally, according to the conditional random fields of the annotation rules and sequence decoding ability to output the sequence annotation results of the maximum probability, In this way, the named entity recognition model of education field is constructed. This paper also uses adversarial training to improve the model accuracy, recall rate and F1 value.

articleTitle: Metaphorical Processing of The Meaning Processing of Tibetan and Chinese Kinship Words: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: A metaphor is a way of representing an abstract concept by means of a concrete concept specific, tangible, and simple origin domain concept mapped to abstract, intangible, and complex concepts of the target domain, thus enables abstract thinking. The study found that abstract concepts such as morality, appreciation, emotion, and social status have corresponding relationships with spatial concepts such as up/down, left/right, and inside/outside. This article uses the Basic language in E-prime software to set up a program and conduct a behavioral experiment. 18 native Chinese students and 18 native Tibetan students participated in this experiment. The experimental results indicate that there is no left and right spatial metaphor in the processing of kinship words by Han people, but there is an upper and lower spatial metaphor (i.e., younger down, older up) (Experiment 1); However, Tibetan native speakers have both left and right spatial metaphors and upper and lower spatial metaphors (i.e., older left, younger right; older up, younger down) in their processing of kinship terms.

articleTitle: Application of Greedy Algorithm in Russian Phonetic Information Processing and Conversion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: In order to understand the application of Russian phonetic information processing and conversion, an application research based on greedy algorithm in Russian phonetic information processing and conversion is put forward. In this paper, firstly, the word-to-sound conversion is regarded as a statistical classification problem, and by determining the Russian characteristics and constraints, the maximum criterion and index, the maximum multi-tone word disambiguation model is constructed. The Russian dictionary is expressed as Markov model, and the language model combining rules and statistics is used to evaluate all conversion paths, and a language analysis tree is established. According to various assumptions and evaluation functions, the optimal conversion path is obtained. Secondly, the greedy algorithm is used to add regularization factors, and the speech signal is set to an appropriate length to complete the rapid conversion of words and sounds. Finally, 500 Russian sentences are randomly selected from TIMIT database for conversion test. The experimental results show that the Russian speech signal output by the proposed method is relatively stable, and the signal loss and conversion error rate are reduced in the word-to-sound conversion.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Swarm Intelligence Algorithm in Mathematics Teaching Quality Evaluation System in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: To gain insights into the development and practical use of a quality evaluation system for mathematics teaching in higher vocational colleges, this study introduces a swarm intelligence algorithm for assessing the quality of mathematics instruction within this educational context. First, this paper analyzes a general evaluation model based on swarm intelligence and presents a swarm intelligence algorithm to evaluate it. By comparing traditional analysis methods, this paper proposes a model for using particle swarm optimization as a training quality evaluation method. Those. Secondly, in accordance with the reality of the higher education institution, the process of evaluating the effectiveness of the teacher’s activities and the evaluation process was developed using the AHP method, and it became possible to extract the evaluation results and evaluate the teacher’s activities. work, research, etc., makes the evaluation of university courses more effective, automatic and objective. Finally, the performance evaluation method of mathematics teaching is tested, showing the basic concept and test steps, and the system is checked with a black box test, which proves the reliability of the process system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Counselor Work Management Information System Based on JavaWeb
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: This study developed a Counselor Work Management Information System to meet the management needs of counselors in higher education. The system adopts a modular, layered architecture and is implemented in Java. It includes three key modules - student management, attendance management, and activity management, enabling functions like student information management, attendance statistics, and activity organization. Testing shows the system satisfies counselor work management requirements and validates key performance indicators. The well-structured design, performance, and scalability enhance counselor work efficiency. In summary, by utilizing mature design and technologies to meet user needs, the system improves counselor work management in higher education institutions.

articleTitle: Research on the establishment and application of Russian vocabulary memory intelligent information system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Vocabulary learning is the basis of learning English. Traditional memory models use mechanical memory methods, which enable users to remember vocabulary in a fixed period of time. These static memory models are complicated to plan, which is not conducive to users’ effective memory of vocabulary. Aiming at the above problems, an intelligent vocabulary memory model is proposed. Starting from the process of biological memory, the Ebbinghaus biological memory curve is quantified by power function, and the learning situation of each Russian word is tracked by the biological memory curve, which reminds users to review in time when Russian words are near the edge of forgetting, and dynamically adjusts the biological memory curve. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional memory model, the model can make an accurate review plan for users, reduce the time for users to master vocabulary by 37. 04%, and has higher memory efficiency.

Author Keywords: Intelligent information system for vocabulary memory

articleTitle: Personalized learning recommendation algorithm based on test questions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: The current personalized learning recommendation has been proposed to improve the efficiency of online teaching, but the current personalized learning recommendation algorithm still has problems such as large redundancy of learning resources, small improvement of learning performance, learner differentiation not fully satisfied and limited recommendation accuracy. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a personalized learning recommendation algorithm based on test questions. The algorithm combines linear regression and EM algorithm to calculate each student’s mastery of each knowledge point. The test practice is used as the basis for pushing other personalized learning resources for students in combination with the knowledge map. The experimental results show that the algorithm has higher recommendation accuracy, recall rate compared with existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Possible Applications of Language Models in Visual Novel
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Visual Novel is a digital game genre that emphasizes textual representation, which means that it is possible to use language models to quickly generate text within them, but the exact methods have not been fully revealed. In order to solve and verify this problem, this paper adopts the literature research method to obtain the logic of the language model and its matching with several important text modules of Visual Novel, including the requirements of the text writing, such as the story line, character dialogue, and multi-branch options. In this paper, GPT-3 technology is taken as an example to carry out fine-tuning experiment, through analysis to determine the fine-tuning steps, so that it is suitable for Visual Novel’s text creation. On this basis, the Q&A template for text generation of Visual Novel is determined. Through practical operation, it can be seen that language model can not only quickly generate the text of visual novel with complete structure, but also be extremely creative and can promote the creation of stories, which is suitable for game development. In summary, this paper provides a practical example of using language models to generate textual content in visual novels, which can provide inspiration for text generation in digital games.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Question-label Classification Model Based on LSTM Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: With the promotion of the whole process and business of the digital transformation of State Grid, the requirements for the digital ability of each business department are getting higher and higher, and higher training and evaluation requirements are also put forward on how to quickly familiarize the company’s personnel with the business and master the operation and production skills. In order to conduct quantitative evaluation and analysis of the skill mastery of the trainees and recommend precise training courses, this paper established a question-label classification model based on the LSTM(Long Short Term Memory) network. This model was based on the training question-label system constructed by manual labeling method, and it combined with the training evaluation work of the State Grid of China Technology College. It realizes the automatic classification and annotation of the imported test questions.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influencing Factors of Second Language Learning Based on Online Learning Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Online instruction has become the mainstream teaching mode for English learners and teachers in universities. The stable and sustainable development of online learning platforms becomes an important issue faced by researchers. This study mainly studies how the individual characteristics and behaviors of relevant stakeholders (teachers, learners and platform enterprises) of online English learning platform affect second language learning. The study shows that online English learning platform can promote online learning and improve L2 learners’ English skills. The study also found that in English teaching practice, besides learners’ inner characteristics, teachers play a key role to improve online English learners’ willingness to learn by creating a helpful pedagogical atmosphere for students. Additionally, to stimulate learners’ enthusiasm for learning, it is crucial to change the classroom from teachers-centered mode to learners-centered mode. Further discussion shows that teachers, learners and platforms need to adjust to the new environment, employing new technologies to improve interaction and build a sustainable learning ecosystem to improve the learning efficiency of L2.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of a Dance Simulation Training System Using VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Dance, as a professional skill, requires extensive repetitive training to achieve a high level of proficiency. However, traditional training methods often lead to issues such as a limited training environment and insufficient interactive experiences. To achieve better dance training results, this study utilizes virtual reality (VR) technology to construct an immersive professional dance training system. The system’s functionality is implemented through modular design, and virtual scenes and interactive methods are developed using platforms such as Unity3D and Vive. Test results demonstrate that the system achieves a highly immersive training effect, improving the interactivity and repeatability of dance training. This research highlights the significant potential of virtual reality technology in professional dance training and provides a valuable example for technological research in this field.

articleTitle: Research on Experimental Teaching Management System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: In order to understand the research of experimental teaching management system, a research of experimental teaching management system based on Internet of Things technology was put forward. In this paper, firstly, a comprehensive teaching experiment system including radio frequency, bar code, wireless communication, GPS positioning and other Internet of Things technologies is proposed. Secondly, the overall structure of the three-layer experimental system consisting of basic technology, technical application and comprehensive experiment is described, and its functions and characteristics are illustrated by a case study of the whole visual monitoring system of supply chain. Finally, the practice shows that the system can meet the teaching needs well. Through the open software and hardware design, the innovation of the system is improved, so that students can have a deeper understanding of related technologies and give full play to their initiative to independently design the Internet of Things system.

articleTitle: Research on the Design Method of Auxiliary Translation Tools Proofreading Subsystem Based on Web TM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: The rapid development of computer information technology has promoted the innovation of translation methods and translation tools, which is reflected in the fact that computer-aided translation technology has been widely used in various translation institutions and companies. In order to ensure the accuracy of computer translation, it is necessary to develop an effective proofreading subsystem. Based on this, this paper analyzes the specific function of computer-aided translation software, introduces the intelligent proofreading method of translation, and discusses the design method of proofreading subsystem of computer-aided translation tools based on Web TM from two aspects: the process of proofreading subsystem and the realization of subsystem error detection, so as to further improve the accuracy of translation results of computer-aided translation tools and reduce the investment of time and human capital.

articleTitle: Research on the Analysis Model System of Examination Assessment of Digital Competence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: In the context of the digital transformation of education, the comprehensive integration of digital technology into State Grid’s training and education is of great significance to the development of training and education and the construction of the company’s talent team. This paper focuses on the training and education of the power communication major, taking training students as the research object, and establishing a digital ability examination evaluation and analysis model system based on the MySql 8.0 database management system to realize the training evaluation and analysis function and provide decision-making support for the talent training of the State Grid Corporation of China.

articleTitle: Opportunities, Challenges, Strategies, and Reforms for ChatGPT in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: ChatGPT is a powerful large language model developed by OpenAI. It has a profound impact on higher education fields. This technology offers exciting opportunities for students and educators, including personalized feedback, increased accessibility, interactive conversations, lecture preparation, performance evaluation, and new ways to teach complex concepts. At the same time, ChatGPT poses different threats and challenges to the traditional high education system, such as the possibility of cheating on online exams, human-like text generation, diminished critical thinking skills, and difficulties in evaluating information generated by ChatGPT. This paper explores the potential opportunities and challenges that ChatGPT poses in higher education from the perspective of students and educators. In higher education, by understanding these challenges and taking steps to mitigate them, we can then ensure the language models to be used in a responsible and ethical way.

articleTitle: ChatGPT Empowers the Informatization of Foreign Language Education in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: ChatGPT is one of the most advanced AI chatbots, which has brought an impact to all walks of life, especially in the field of foreign language education. By analyzing the specific application of ChatGPT and using examples of dialogue with it, this paper aims to explore the application and practice of ChatGPT in foreign language education in colleges and universities, including its potential and effect in practice dialogue, simulated communication, language assessment and personalized learning. Even ChatGPT provides an all-weather, adaptive, and interactive learning environment in foreign language learning in higher education, which can effectively promote the improvement of students’ language expression, comprehension, and interaction skills. However, further investigation and practice are still needed to address the limitations and challenges current exist to achieve a higher level of foreign language education quality and learning effects.

Author Keywords: Foreign Language Education in Colleges and universities

articleTitle: Construction of a Web-Based Remote Training Platform for Rural Preschool Teachers in China
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: In the face of the varying levels of professional competence among rural preschool teachers, this study aims to enhance their professional abilities by constructing a web-based remote training platform. Employing software engineering methods, the study designed and developed functional modules such as video on-demand, discussion forums, and resource downloads. A survey was conducted on 100 rural preschool teachers who had used this training platform, and the results indicated that 95% of the teachers were highly satisfied with the platform, with 65% reporting an improvement in their teaching skills. The research demonstrates that web-based training platforms can effectively promote the professional development of rural teachers and serve as a vital means to expand the coverage of teacher training in rural areas. However, the sample size in this study was relatively small, and the operational support mechanisms of the platform require further exploration. Subsequent research will expand the sample size to assess the effectiveness of online training, enrich platform content, and better meet the needs of rural teachers. This study provides valuable insights and experiences for the development of information technology in rural education in China.

articleTitle: The development research of student management information system based on Web
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Student management information system (MIS) is emerging in the current educational environment and provides an efficient and reliable solution for school management. Compared with the traditional manual management, this system not only improves the management efficiency, but also reduces the potential error risk. Through in-depth requirements analysis and B/S network architecture, this research successfully designed a fully functional and excellent system, especially in the aspects of student and course management. The wide application prospect of the system provides strong support for schools to better manage student information, curriculum arrangements and grade records, improve management efficiency and reduce the risk of data processing errors. This system represents the modern educational management trend and provides the school with a solid foundation in an ever-changing educational environment.

articleTitle: Application and Implementation Methods of VR Technology in Higher Education Mechanical Manufacturing Programs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Virtual reality technology, through computer-generated three-dimensional virtual environments, provides users with immersive interactive experiences and holds great potential for application in mechanical manufacturing education. This study designed a modular virtual reality simulation system that achieved detailed three-dimensional mechanical models and realistic physical interaction effects. User experiment results showed that 93% of users successfully completed interactive tasks, with 80% expressing satisfaction. The research demonstrates that virtual reality technology can significantly enhance students’ interest in learning and allow them to immerse themselves in mechanical operations. This study introduces, for the first time, a virtual reality simulation system tailored to the field of mechanical manufacturing and empirically validates its effectiveness in education, indicating that virtual reality technology is a highly effective emerging teaching tool with great potential applications. Future work will focus on optimizing the system for a smoother user experience.

articleTitle: Design and Teaching Application of Pronunciation Recognition Software in Russian Phonetics Class
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional Russian spoken pronunciation correction system can’t correct and feedback students’ pronunciation errors in time, a Russian spoken phonetics correction system based on speech recognition is designed. The system uses MFCC method to extract Russian spoken pronunciation signal, which can make the signal closer to human auditory perception system. It uses the error-eliminating algorithm to correct and identify the pronunciation signals extracted from features, which effectively improves the pronunciation recognition accuracy, and uses the path, audio comparison and robust optimization algorithm to correct. The experimental results show that the proposed method can identify and correct the wrong pronunciation, and the response time of the system is short, which proves that the system has good performance and realizes the scientific and accurate pronunciation correction system of spoken Russian. To a great extent, the system correction ability is improved, and the problems of confusion in recognition and high correction errors in the traditional Russian spoken pronunciation correction system are solved.

articleTitle: Research on the application of Neural Network Model in Knowledge graph completion technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: Knowledge Graph (KG) is a technology that employs graph models to represent knowledge and model the interconnected relationships among entities. The purpose of knowledge graph completion techniques is to automatically fill in missing entities, attributes, and relationships within an existing knowledge graph through inference and learning methods. In recent years, neural network models have emerged as powerful learning frameworks and have found extensive applications in the domain of knowledge graph completion. This paper presents a comprehensive investigation and analysis of the application of neural network models in knowledge graph completion techniques. Explored the challenges faced by knowledge graph completion techniques such as sparse data. Point out the future development direction, multimodal fusion and incremental learning knowledge graph completion. The objective is to provide valuable insights and assistance for the advancement of research in knowledge graph completion techniques.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Online Simulation Training Platform for Logistics Management Based on PHP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: With the update iteration of digital information technology, the digitalization and intelligence level of the logistics industry as a whole has risen linearly. At the same time, the transformation and upgrading of the operation and management mode of logistics enterprises has also aggravated the contradiction between supply and demand of compound logistics management professionals. In this regard, based on the problems of insufficient practical training education and the disconnection between production and education in the current logistics management talent training mode, this paper designs an online simulation training platform for logistics management based on PHP, thus making up for the deficiency of traditional teaching mode and helping to cultivate logistics management talents in the new era. The system will use PHP as a script to realize the overall construction and development of the platform, and integrate virtual reality technology to form functional modules for simulation training. It is convenient for teachers and students to complete many tasks such as remote login, online teaching, simulated training and teaching evaluation through simple and convenient operation, so as to control the whole teaching process and promote the two-way promotion of theory and practice. The actual test results show that the application of online simulation training platform is of great significance for changing teaching mode, improving teaching quality and tapping talent potential.

articleTitle: Construction of ideological and political assisted learning platform for image information processing course under mixed teaching mode
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: In the context of rapid development in educational informatization, blended teaching models are widely applied in universities. Exploring how to effectively integrate professional course instruction with ideological and political education is an important topic. This study takes a course on image information processing at a certain university as an example and designs and constructs a specialized ideological and political education support platform to promote the development of ideological and political education within the course. Through research and analysis of blended teaching models, the current status of ideological and political education, and the characteristics of the course, the requirements for platform construction are clarified. Mainstream technology is employed to design and implement the platform’s framework, functional modules, and innovative features. Empirical research is conducted to validate the practical effectiveness of the platform. The results show that the platform can enhance students’ interest in learning and the internalization of ideological and political theories. This study provides an effective approach for the development of ideological and political education in similar courses and explores new directions for the deep integration of professional teaching and ideological and political education.

articleTitle: GIS Gas Analysis Training Program Based on K-Means Clustering Method Training Auxiliary Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Educational Knowledge and Informatization (EKI)
abstract: The SF6 gas leakage of GIS equipment is an important factor affecting the normal safe and stable operation of equipment, so GIS gas analysis project is an important training work for improving professional technical skills in operation and maintenance integration, an important way to comprehensively improve substation operation and maintenance personnel, and a key step to achieve operation and inspection integration. However, how to correctly reflect the rationality of the scoring setting of the assessment items and the importance of key skills are thorny issues that each unit must face in training. Based on the skill assessment results of 600 students from 27 participating units in a training unit in 2022, this paper conducts multi-dimensional in-depth analysis from the practical training project and key skill items, constructs the evaluation index of teaching quality, and adjusts the key skill items of GIS gas analysis project through cluster analysis and adjusts the results, the adjusted settings are more reasonable, the focus of trainers’ lectures is more prominent, and the students’ operational skills improvement is more targeted.
